title: Thoughts on my refreshed combat experience?
author: v1dal
selftext:
I still want to redo the logs in the middle, but so far so happy, unified world bottom hud (still some work to do to nail it) with the combat hud so the switch is smooth.

Current combat experience can be tried on [https://berrus.app](https://berrus.app)

This new version will be a complete new game!

comments.author: v1dal
comments.body:
If anyone is interested, game is already playable and with dozens of active players on [https://berrus.app](https://berrus.app).

Is free to play mix of Path of Exile and RuneScape.

Coming soon to [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4126930/Berrus/) (wishlist please!).

Currently working on a complete overhaul that will turn it into a "real" profesional game. Aiming to ship this new version in 1-2 months, just in time to steal the spotlight of GTA 😛

comments.author: Initial_Plastic_8069
comments.body: you need music, it is still too sterile

replies.author: v1dal
replies.body: I have! It's cool, not recorded on the video!

comments.author: Time_Cat_5212
comments.body: I like the idea, but I don't love the interface.  It looks like you took all the guts and put them haphazardly on a transparent overlay of the main map.  I'd prefer either a contained modal or a SVBS sort of thing with sprites and animations.

replies.author: v1dal
replies.body: Agreed, already improved it following that direction!
